text:
Nia Rivera: hey team, brand-new hire here. quick q: where do i put the "first-week checklist" and the teamwiki in Notion? also who can grant edit access?

DocsBot: Hi Nia! Start with Company Docs > People > Onboarding for checklists. Team wikis typically live under Company Docs > Engineering > <Team Name> > Wiki. Use the doc access request form: https://forms.redwood.com/doc-access or tag a devex lead.

Ben O'Leary: +1. If you're on Platform, path is Company Docs > Engineering > Platform > Wiki. We keep a little TOC at the top with a "Last updated" property.

Jules: When you create a page from a template, duplicate -> move it into the team folder. Important: change the page owner and add the team group under Share so it's not stuck in your personal space.

Nia Rivera: ok thanks. one more - templates: where are the runbook and meeting-note templates?

Ben O'Leary: Templates are under Company Docs > Templates > Engineering. Runbook template is "Playbook - Runbook (v2)" and meeting notes is "Meeting Notes - dated". Use the date format YYYY-MM-DD in the title for notes.

Jules: FYI if you get a 403 on move, it's usually because the destination folder has restricted access. Send the exact page link and I can update permissions.

Nia Rivera: thanks! filed a doc access form and pinged @Jules here. copying the runbook template now. :smile:
